typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tocalypsotradeservproductdesc_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		PRODUCT_ID as decimal(38,0),
		PRODUCT_FAMILY as string,
		MATURITY_DATE as timestamp,
		DESCRIPTION as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromcalypsoproductdesc
fromcalypsoproductdesc derive({Copy of DESCRIPTION} = DESCRIPTION,
		{PRODUCT_ID$} = toString(PRODUCT_ID),
		{PRODUCT_FAMILY$} = PRODUCT_FAMILY,
		{Copy of MATURITY_DATE} = MATURITY_DATE) ~> DataConversionProductId
DataConversionProductId sink(input(
		product_family as string,
		product_id as string,
		description as string,
		maturity_date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,errorHandlingOption: 'allErrors',reportSuccessOnError: true,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		product_family = {PRODUCT_FAMILY$},
		product_id = {PRODUCT_ID$},
		description = {Copy of DESCRIPTION},
		maturity_date = MATURITY_DATE),
	partitionFileNames:[($tocalypsotradeservproductdesc_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tocalypsotradeservproductdesc
